attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Illinois state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.95% tax structure per IL tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Illinois Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi 0.0495 mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Illinois tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Illinois military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per 35 ILCS 5/203 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Illinois military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Illinois Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.il_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.il_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.il_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.il_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.il_military_retirement_exclusion result.il_sbp_exclusion add /result.il_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.il_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.il_adjusted_agi xdef
"Illinois military retirement exclusion: $" result.il_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.il_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Illinois SBP exclusion: $" result.il_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Illinois total military exclusion: $" result.il_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
